full_prompt_en: The image is a square mixed-media-looking painting of a cluster of colored round forms rising above a quiet waterfront. A worn pale gray and cream ground fills the upper part, crossed by faint seams, scratches, stains, and bits of exposed underpainting. Near the center, circles of unequal size overlap loosely in an upward-spreading cluster. The largest pale pink disk sits high on the left; a vivid yellow disk anchors the lower middle, surrounded by smaller blue, apricot, mint, brown, burgundy, black, and white forms. A separate orange-red circle floats near the upper right, and isolated tiny spots are scattered around the main group. Several fine vertical lines descend from the lower circles toward a small, crowded structure at the waterline, suggesting tethered decorations without closing off the airy space. That low structure is built from many minute stacked dabs of pink, yellow, blue, black, and cream. A thin dark green strip of distant trees runs horizontally behind it, separating the gray sky from calm blue-gray water. Across the bottom, a broad rough charcoal band cuts through the water; broken turquoise, pale pink, and ochre strokes show below and around it. The viewpoint stays level and distant, letting the colored circles carry more presence than the tiny landscape. Light is even and cloudy, with the bright disks reading as flat pigment rather than glowing lamps. Their crisp round edges sit against rubbed, scuffed, and thinly washed surroundings. The composition balances a compact vertical rise of color against long low horizontal bands, making the weathered surface and floating spacing as important as any single form.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、带混合媒材观感的绘画：一簇彩色圆形升在安静水岸上方。磨旧的浅灰和奶油色底面占据上部，其间横过隐约接缝、刮痕、污点与露出的底层颜料。中央附近，不同大小的圆盘松松重叠成向上散开的聚团。最大的浅粉圆盘在左上，鲜黄圆盘压住中下部，周围分布较小的蓝、杏、薄荷绿、棕、酒红、黑和白色圆形。另一块橙红色圆盘独立浮在右上，零星小点散在主团四周。几根细竖线从下部圆形落向水线旁一小块拥挤结构，暗示被牵系的装饰，却不封闭通透空间。那块低矮结构由许多粉、黄、蓝、黑和奶油色的极小叠笔搭成。一道细深绿远树带横贯其后，把灰天空与安静蓝灰水面分开。下部，一条宽而粗糙的炭黑带切过水面；碎青绿、浅粉和赭色笔痕在其下及周围露出。视点保持平直而远，让彩色圆形比微小风景更有存在感。光均匀而多云，明亮圆盘读作平面颜料，而非发光灯。清脆圆边与擦磨、刮旧和薄洗的周围表面相接。构图让紧凑向上的色彩聚团与漫长低矮的横带相平衡，使风化表面与漂浮间距同任一形状一样重要。
style_prompt_en: A layered mixed-media paint surface sets clean, flat circles and tiny dots against rubbed gray-cream fields. Pale pink, mustard yellow, faded turquoise, apricot, wine red, mint, and black appear as unevenly spaced accents rather than continuous gradients. Fine vertical hairlines connect a loose upper cluster to a dense low knot of miniature marks. Long horizontal bands below establish calm breadth, with a rough charcoal passage interrupting thin blue-gray washes. Scratches, stains, visible seams, and exposed older color give the support an aged tactile quality. Light remains diffuse, so the sharp edges of the circles and the contrast of color area carry the focal strength. The rhythm moves between scattered airiness above and compressed textured density below.
style_prompt_zh: 层叠的混合媒材颜料表面把干净平涂的圆形与微小点粒放在擦磨过的灰奶油色区域上。浅粉、芥黄、褪色青绿、杏、酒红、薄荷绿和黑色作为间距不均的点缀出现，而非连续渐变。细若发丝的竖线把松散的上部聚团连到下方密集的微小痕迹结点。下部漫长横带建立安静的宽度，一道粗糙炭黑段落打断较薄的蓝灰晕洗。刮痕、污点、可见接缝和露出的旧色让载体带陈旧而可触的质感。光保持漫散，因此圆形的清晰边缘与色彩面积对比承担焦点强度。节奏在上方散落的通透感与下方压缩的纹理密度之间移动。
